notes.subject: sheḇer/nishberah
notes.rationale: 'a great fracture — fractured is the virgin daughter': noun and verb from the same root שבר, a broken echo lost in Bambara

notes.subject: butɔrɔba
notes.rationale: בתולת 'virgin' rendered 'unmarried-girl' to keep her social shape, not a doctrinal one

notes.subject: to the people
notes.rationale: Yawe commands Jeremiah to address this word to the people (elahem)

translation: I na u ye kuma nin fɔ: N ka ɲɛw bɛna jijidɔn bɔ su ni tile la, k'u ma ban, sabu butɔrɔsurun — n ka jamanaden butɔrɔba, Wɛ Tɔgɔ Yawe de bɛ fɔ —
